rationale: WMG has pulled back directly into the confluence of session VWAP ($32.61) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($32.56) after an initial gap-and-rally, creating a neutral inflection zone where shorting hits immediate dynamic support and going long fights active 1-minute selling momentum without a confirmed bounce. Furthermore, the bid-ask spread is very wide at 45.9 bps ($0.15, or ~45% of the 5-minute ATR), which severely degrades execution and risk-reward at a tijd when 85.5% of buying power is already committed and half the daily loss budget is consumed.
